source: BodyParts3D named surfaces and HRA named components
brainCortex: Available named gyri grouped by cortical region; not a complete cortical parcellation
heartVentricles: Cavity and papillary-muscle surfaces; no invented ventricular wall
lungRegistration: Revision 13: original HRA bilateral scale and one shared translation for both lungs and all children; see lung-audit.json
coordinateRule: All child vertices retain their source registration; only exploded mode displaces them

appendixCorrection.maleAppendix: BodyParts3D FJ2565, FMA14542; original native coordinates
appendixCorrection.maleCecum: BodyParts3D FMA14541 resolves to FJ2599 ileocecal junction; moved from common ileum to male colon
appendixCorrection.femaleAppendix: Existing HRA node 490 and cecum node 493; geometry and registration unchanged
appendixCorrection.sexRule: One appendix and one cecum in each sex configuration; presence is not a sex difference

spine.sacrum: Both original sacra individually selectable as fused S1–S5; linked from spine, rendered once within pelvic hierarchy
spine.coccyx: Female HRA node 964 individually selectable; no separately supplied male surface; presence is not a sex difference

vagina: Native external vaginal envelope and cervicovaginal junction; no synthetic mucosal folds or lumen reconstruction
